**Mexico: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 717,847 applications. The largest annual volume was 140,979 in 2023; 2025 recorded 70,482. Applications in 2025 were 0.2% higher than in 2019 (70,363). In 2025, 101,904 recorded decisions equated to 145 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 11% lower than in 2024 (78,966). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 4 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Cuba (34,581), Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) (14,321), Haiti (9,074).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 80%, across 21,912 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 78% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 0.5 percentage points higher than in 2024 (79%).
